title: Chapter 752 Not Worthy; Comprehension!
content:
Chapter 752 Not Worthy; Comprehension!

Chapter 752  Not Worthy; Comprehension!

In the following period of time, Ke Xin followed Lin Chengzhen with the excuse of repaying his kindness.

Gradually, their feelings for each other continued to heat up. They began to hold hands and hug each other…They became true lovers.

They did all the things that lovers should do together.

24 hours a day, they were almost never apart, and they were extremely happy.

Lin Chengzhen finally felt the sweetness of love.

....

At this moment, in the dark universe, in the majestic building known as the central palace.

A man wearing a python robe and emitting a powerful aura let out a rumbling sound.

"Have you found Princess Kexin?"

Below, a man in a red and black robe knelt on the ground and said respectfully,"Venerable Sovereign, the princess is in the Three Eastern Regions."

"Also, we found out that the princess seems to have feelings for a man.""

"Hmm?" The man in the python robe's tone suddenly sank. A terrifying aura surged out like a tide, making people feel suffocated.

"Who is he? Give me the detailed information."

"Yes," the red-robed man said nervously."

Then, a streak of red light flew toward the man.

The next moment, the man in the python robe shouted,"A domain lord level brat actually dares to covet my daughter, really…How dare he not take a look at his identity! Is he worthy?"

"Go, bring Princess Ke Xin back!"

"Yes, sir!" The red-robed man hurriedly said.

....

At this moment, Lin Chengzhen and Ke Xin were strolling along a bustling street, holding hands.

Lin Chengzhen maintained his smile.

This period of time was the happiest and most blissful time since he left Earth.

Ke Xin's face had a hint of worry.

Because, not long ago, she accidentally discovered her father's subordinate.

This made her feel uneasy.

Ke Xin knew her father very well. He was a domineering, high-status man who valued family status.

He would never allow himself to be with Lin Chengzhen.

Lin Chengzhen seemed to have sensed the change in Kexin and could not help but ask,""Kexin, what's wrong? Are you feeling unwell?"

"Cheng Zhen, I want to tell you something."

"Tell me." Lin Chengzhen said.

"Whoosh!"

At this moment…

The originally clear sky suddenly became covered with dark clouds. Strong winds howled and thunder roared.

In the next moment…

The sky above his head seemed to have been torn apart by a huge thunder, and a long ravine appeared.

And inside the ravine…A man in golden armor walked out.

With a wave of his hand, a terrifying energy that was like a tidal wave instantly turned all the people on the street into ashes.

This was a terrifying power that attacked indiscriminately. Fortunately, Kexin blocked in front of Lin Chengzhen in time, so he was not attacked.

Lin Chengzhen felt a suffocating aura from the man in golden armor.

However, he was not afraid.

Instead, he puffed out his chest and vaguely protected Ke Xin behind him. He said warily,"Who are you?"

"Me?" The golden-armored man seemed to have heard the best joke in the world. He grinned and said," A mere ant is worthy of asking my name?!"

As soon as he finished speaking, a gust of wind seemed to be about to blow Lin Chengzhen away at any moment.

When the golden-armored man was about to make another move, Ke Xin, who was beside him, said," Enough!"

"Brother Ji Wei, don't continue!"

The golden-armored man's aura suddenly turned cold as he said,""Since Kexin has spoken, then forget it."

"Kexin, the Venerable Sovereign wants you to go back. Let's not make him wait for too long, right?"

"Otherwise, the Venerable Sovereign might get angry."

Ke Xin didn't answer immediately. He turned to Lin Chengzhen and said,""Chengzhen, I'm sorry. I have to go home."

"I'll go back with you," Lin Chengzhen said."

Ke Xin shook his head." Not yet. Don't come looking for me. Wait for me to come to you." Trust me, it won't take long."

Then, she said to the man in golden armor,""Brother Ji Wei, let's go."

"Alright." the golden-armored man replied.

The two of them walked towards the crack in the sky.

Lin Chengzhen hurriedly chased after him and said,"Karma!""

"Brat, how can you covet Heart-Crushing Princess? Get lost!" " Die!" The golden-armored man roared and formed countless blades that shot toward Lin Chengzhen. He was sent flying and spat out a mouthful of blood.

"Ji Wei!" Ke Xin shouted.

"Sister Wang, I'm doing this for your own good," said the golden-armored man."

This was the last sound.

The sky gradually returned to normal.

Only Lin Chengzhen was left on the spot, extremely dispirited. He kept muttering,"Karma…It's heartbreaking..."

....

Earth.

Coiling Dragon Villa.

Lin Fan didn't know about his eldest son, Lin Chengzhen.

He played with his youngest son and grew up together…

Then, he began to cultivate bitterly.

Time passed in cultivation, and in the blink of an eye, a hundred years had passed.

70 years ago, Lin Fan's cultivation state had already reached Emperor level 9.

In the next 50 years, the energy in his body kept growing and condensing.

However, there were no signs of a breakthrough.

However, 20 years ago, his energy and condensing speed had both dropped to a low point. It was as if he had reached a bottleneck and was unable to make any progress.

Lin Fan decided not to increase his energy and turned to study cultivation techniques.

Over the years, he had already mastered all the cultivation techniques and could easily circulate them to the extreme, greatly increasing his strength.

Then, Lin Fan set his sights on the Great Dao.

Thus, he entered the River of Time and continued walking, comprehending the Great Dao.

Gradually, other than the path of time, the paths of space, metal, wood, water, fire, earth, sword, saber, spear, and so on were all one million meters away.

On the long road, Lin Fan was the only one walking alone.

Dao had finally reached its limit.

However, he still did not feel like he was about to break through.

On this day, Lin Fan walked in the courtyard of the Coiling Dragon Villa. He looked at the swaying flowers around him, looked at the floating clouds in the sky, and listened to the chirping of the birds on the branches…Everything was so easy and natural.

For a moment, Lin Fan felt as though he had broken through a thin layer.

However, this thin film quickly disappeared.

This caused Lin Fan to sink into deep thought.

Holy Master?

It transcended the world and originated from the world.

All these years, he had been staying in the Coiling Dragon Villa and had completely lost the opportunity to experience the world.

Perhaps he had to go out for a walk to have an opportunity to break through.

If he wanted to do it, he would do it.

Lin Fan didn't tell Hu Tian and the others about this.

Instead, he took a step forward alone and instantly appeared on the streets of Earth's city.

As a result, Coiling Dragon Villa lost a powerhouse with monstrous strength.

There was an ordinary pedestrian in the city.
